result.reason: The redline appropriately makes the restriction mutual, removes the no-hire prohibition, narrows the covered personnel, and adds carve-outs. However, the 12-month period runs from the end of the agreement rather than from the end of each person’s involvement, potentially extending the restriction beyond the fallback. The unrestricted carve-out for “recruiter searches” also goes beyond the stated fallback and could permit targeted solicitation through recruiters. Otherwise, the drafting generally preserves the clause’s commercial purpose.
